args.text: Six pirates on the west edge, everyone to the wall.

turns.event: The solar flare ends. Power returns to the whole base.
turns.think: End of flare is new information. Short confirmation.

args.text: Power's back, nothing spoiled.

turns.event: The expedition team enters level two of the backrooms.
turns.think: New level, worth a quick line to set the scene.

args.text: Level two, pipes everywhere and it's way too warm.

turns.think: Just walking. Let the tension sit.

turns.think: This is the moment. One line.

args.text: Okay, something is staring at us, nobody move.

turns.think: It left. A small relieved breath, not a speech.

args.text: And it's gone. I'm going to pretend that was fine.

args.text: Eight medicine, which should carry us through winter.

turns.after: Stores the medicine in the hospital.

args.text: It is, looks like steel, free stuff.
